title: prepared statement already exists errors when connecting to Supabase through the pooler on port 6543
symptoms: Errors appear only under concurrent load, not in local tests
postgres.js queries hang or return rows meant for another query
cause: Transaction mode hands the connection back to the pool after each transaction, so per-session state such as prepared statements and pipelined queries leaks between clients. Most drivers prepare statements by default.
fix: Turn off prepared statements in the driver when using port 6543, or use session mode or a direct connection for code that needs them, including migrations.
affected: Supabase Supavisor transaction mode (port 6543) with Prisma, postgres.js, Drizzle, asyncpg, JDBC
